Where things stand today

Troopod ran a TrooPerformance Trial across three Mamaearth templates (Homepage, Collection, Product), one live page per template, taking the average Speed Index from 17.7s to 8.0s. Further gains from here are gated by third-party app scripts, which sit outside the theme and outside our direct control unless we coordinate with the app vendors themselves (see Track 2).

How we'll get there

1

Monthly audit cadence

Troopod re audits every month, flags the delta, and works to achieve and maintain the score delivered via the optimisation.

2

Change guidelines

A living guideline doc for your tech and dev agency so future changes don't quietly erode speed.

Terms & notes
  1. The 15% band: Lighthouse scores fluctuate by device, network and time of day. A result within ±15% of the Speed Index target is treated as within target.
  2. Change guidelines: a living guideline doc will be shared for your tech and dev agency and must be strictly followed on every future change, so gains aren't quietly eroded.
  3. Track 1 scope limit: score impact coming from third-party plugins and apps cannot be delivered under Track 1, it's out of scope there and covered only under Track 2.
  4. Track 2 dependency: plugin and app side work needs direct intervention with vendors, which depends on introductions and cooperation from the Mamaearth team.
  5. Measurement tool: Speed Index is measured via Lighthouse 13.4.1, mobile preset, unless stated otherwise.
  6. Proposal validity: these commercials are valid for 15 days from the date of this proposal.
  7. Payment terms: the one-time fee is payable in advance of deploying the optimised theme; recurring maintenance fees are payable quarterly in advance.
  8. Taxes: applicable taxes, if any, will be charged additionally.
  9. Team dependency: this engagement needs prompt support, connects, and approvals from the Mamaearth team; a delay of more than 3 days on any of these will affect deliverables, and Troopod will not be held responsible for the resulting impact.
